summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for El Rey de los Tacos digital menu app. 14/14 backend pytest tests passed (auth, public reads, auth protection, full CRUD on categories/products/sauces with persistence verification). Frontend menu, sauce modal (2-of-7 logic), GREEN cart drawer, WhatsApp checkout, QR modal, franchise button, admin login (good and bad creds), and admin CRUD UI for Categories/Products/Sauces all verified working. Cart background confirmed rgb(22,163,74) (#16A34A). WhatsApp links target wa.me/5491155644915. Image preview in product dialog works.

issues: React hydration warning: nested <button> inside <button> (Radix Checkbox button rendered inside outer sauce-option <button>). Functionally works but emits console error. Recommendation: replace outer <button> with a <div role='button' tabIndex={0}> or wrap with a <label> + hidden input, since the inner Checkbox is already a button.
A11y warning: Missing `Description`/`aria-describedby` on DialogContent for SauceModal, QRModal, Cart Sheet, Admin dialogs. Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to silence.

action_items: (Optional polish) Fix nested-button hydration warning in SauceModal by removing outer <button> or removing inner Checkbox button.
(Optional polish) Add DialogDescription to dialogs to silence Radix a11y warnings.
Backend hardcodes admin credentials and a static ADMIN_TOKEN in server.py; OK per user's explicit request but flag for future hardening (move to env, hash password, rotate token).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses hardcoded ADMIN_USER/ADMIN_PASS/ADMIN_TOKEN constants - acceptable per user request but should be env-driven for production.
Startup seed runs only on empty DB; idempotent. Good.
MongoDB queries correctly project out _id; no ObjectId leaks confirmed by tests.
Frontend correctly uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL via lib/api.js; no hardcoded URLs.
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes - excellent test coverage.
SauceModal correctly enforces exactly 2 selections (3rd option is auto-disabled when 2 selected, confirm button disabled until exactly 2).
CartDrawer correctly conditionally shows address input only when mode='envio'.
seed_data_creation: None - relied on backend auto-seeded data (4 cats, 9 products, 7 sauces). Test data created during CRUD cycles was cleaned up after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All flows verified end-to-end on production URL. Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_rey_tacos_api.py covers auth, seeding, CRUD with persistence verification - run with: pytest backend/tests/test_rey_tacos_api.py -v. Two console warnings exist (nested button in SauceModal, missing DialogDescription) but neither blocks any functionality.
